node.title: Re: parse 'get' URL
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: For more [mod://CGI].pm alternatives, see the threads [id://1177808] and [id://1182902]. If, as your title might imply, all you want to do is parse a URL for the query parameters, see [mod://URI::QueryParam]. Note that none of these modules are in the core, including [mod://CGI].pm [doc://perl5220delta#Removed-Modules-and-Pragmata|as of Perl v5.22] (two years ago).
